Method of Attack: Ransomware operation applying maximum pressure by emailing victims' customers to demand ransom payments
Double-extortion tactic stealing unencrypted data before encrypting victim's network and threatening to release data if ransom is not paid
DDoSing victims or making VOIP calls to victims' customers to apply further pressure
Indicators of Compromise: Emails threatening customers with data leaks
Emails with subject 'Your personal data has been stolen and will be published.'
